I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
hand_knob:
- 5.30 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

{"note":"Unchanged fit: the feedback on the 5.30 mm retaining opening was inconclusive, so there is no basis to tighten or loosen it yet. This is a one-piece knob with six flexible retaining fingers, a recessed nut seat, and a bolt passage through the opposite face. Please check hand insertion and inverted retention on this reprint.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":5.5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M3 across flats."},"nut_thickness":{"value":2.4,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":3,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":20,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_h":{"value":9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_t":{"value":1.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_recess":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bore_allowance":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral bolt clearance."},"pedestal_r":{"value":2.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"well_r":{"value":5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_count":{"value":6,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_inner_r":{"value":2.95,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_outer_r":{"value":3.65,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_width":{"value":2.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_root_overlap":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"retention_interference":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Opposing retaining faces are 5.30 mm apart; nominal finger deflection is 0.10 mm each."},"bump_start_above_seat":{"value":0.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bump_ramp_h":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"entry_lead_h":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"entry_extra_radius":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_r":{"value":1.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"grip_cut_offset":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"hand_knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    seat = p.knob_h - p.nut_recess - p.nut_thickness
    bore = (p.bolt_d + p.bore_allowance)/2
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(p.knob_h)
    well = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).circle(p.well_r).extrude(p.knob_h)
    body = body.cut(well)
    pedestal = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.pedestal_r).extrude(seat)
    body = body.union(pedestal)
    z0 = p.floor_t - p.finger_root_overlap
    zb = seat + p.bump_start_above_seat
    zc = zb + p.bump_ramp_h
    zl = p.knob_h - p.entry_lead_h
    ri = p.finger_inner_r
    rb = (p.nut_af-p.retention_interference)/2
    re = p.nut_af/2+p.entry_extra_radius
    ro = p.finger_outer_r
    profile = [(ri,z0),(ri,zb),(rb,zc),(rb,zl),(re,p.knob_h),(ro,p.knob_h),(ro,z0)]
    finger = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.finger_width/2,both=True)
    for i in range(int(p.finger_count)):
        body = body.union(finger.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),i*360/p.finger_count))
    for i in range(int(p.grip_count)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.grip_count
        r = p.knob_d/2+p.grip_cut_offset
        cutter = cq.Workplane('XY').center(r*math.cos(a),r*math.sin(a)).circle(p.grip_cut_r).extrude(p.knob_h)
        body = body.cut(cutter)
    hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(bore).extrude(p.knob_h)
    return body.cut(hole).clean()

The nut must not spin inside it during light hand tightening. Recheck inverted retention after several tightening cycles."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print hand_knob with its closed underside on the bed and the opening upward. Use the 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, at least 4 walls, and 5 top/bottom layers. No supports: leave the flexible fingers and their surrounding gaps unobstructed.","parts":["hand_knob"]},{"n":"2","text":"Allow the print to cool. Remove loose strings without cutting or bending the fingers. Confirm all six fingers are separate above the floor and that the central passage is clear.","parts":["hand_knob"]},{"n":"3","text":"Align each M3 nut flat with one finger. Press straight down by hand until the nut rests on the central pedestal, with its top approximately 1 mm below the rim. Do not hammer it or use a bolt to force it into place.","parts":["hand_knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"Invert over a tray and lightly shake. Report two results: whether the nut could be seated by hand, and whether it remained inside when inverted. The previous 5.30 mm fit result was unknown, so this reprint intentionally uses the same fit.","parts":["hand_knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"5","text":"If it is loose, increase retention_interference by 0.1 mm and reprint. If it cannot be seated by hand, decrease retention_interference by 0.1 mm and reprint. Do not accept a loose or cracked part; nominal nut sizes and printer tolerances make a physical fit check necessary.","parts":["hand_knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Feed your M3 bolt through the closed underside and turn the knob to engage the nut. Confirm the bolt passes through the nut and emerges on the open side without the nut spinning. Bolt length depends on your application and is not specified here.","parts":["hand_knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"7","text":"Use for light hand tightening, not wrench-level torque or safety-critical clamping. Recheck retention after several cycles and periodically afterward. Keep away from heat; PLA fingers may relax over time.","parts":["hand_knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
